hub._relay_comment: A standalone worker sends its chat events to the backend's hub (services/chat/relay.py): at most relay_queue_size wait to go, relay_batch_size to a frame.

choice._comment: The words of the chat's model picker (services/chat/choice.py, get_chat_models): Auto's row, the three thinking levels (the id is the effort sent: low, nothing for Balanced, high), the line shown for a model that picks its own pace, and the refusals. {model} is a model's name, {provider} a provider's, {name} the employee's.

efforts.label: Balanced
efforts.hint: A good mix of speed and care

choice.unavailable: {model} can’t answer right now: {provider} isn’t connected. Connect it in Settings > Connectors, or pick another model.
choice.default_unavailable: Your default model, {model}, can’t answer right now: {provider} isn’t connected. Connect it in Settings > Connectors, or pick another model.
choice.not_offered: That model isn’t offered any more. Pick another one.

commands._comment: Slash commands every workflow's chat offers (get_chat_context); an employee's apps add theirs (employee_apps.json commands). fill is the text the command puts in the message box; suggest also shows it in an empty chat. {name} is the employee's name.

generic.fill: Summarize what we’ve agreed so far.
